newsitem.title: UK: European vegetable oils close off day's highs.
newsitem.headline: European vegetable oils close off day's highs.

text.p: European vegetable oil prices closed off their highs for the day following a slightly lower opening in Chicago.
While most sector were only slightly down coconut oil sellers took a bit of a hammering when dealers started to sell the market down.
Coconut oil sellers were $12.50 to $17.50 down by the close after a flurry of light trading.
"People were getting fed up with the market and decided to take on the sellers, but there was no volume behined the business," said a trader.
Dec/Jan coconut oil traded at $775, Jan/Feb at $765, $762.50 and $760 a tonne cif.
Palmkernel oil finished $5 down after Feb traded at $755 and $750 a tonne cif.
Dutch/EU rape oil closed 0.50 to one guilders up after Jan traded at 91.75 and 92 guilders a 100 kilos fob ex-mill.
Dutch soy oil closed one to 1.50 guilders up.
Based on sellers' prices rape oil is offered at a premium of three to four guilders at the close unchanged from Thursday.
Palm oil was quiet during the afternoon although traders said there was a lot of talking going on.
"People are talking but unfortunately no business is resulting from the talk," said one trader.
Crude palm oil cif Europe and refined palm oil fob Malaysia closed unchanged to $2.50 up with no further business reported. --Jim Ballantyne, London Newsroom +44 171 542 8062
